property_recovery.notes: The final GRU is fitted on all 200 training cubes, unlike the training-cube cross-validation probe reported during tuning. It reads one complete first episode; z is fitted from five lifts, so the information budgets differ. The GRU is an empirical recovery benchmark, not a mathematical upper bound. Both diagnostic property decoders are frozen before final held-out evaluation.
